cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And I kept it. Your care is safe because of mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

mechanism: A judges caring contributions and claims custody of B gift as proof A care outranks even B preserved collection.
confusable: D67 ranks any contribution for superiority; D91 specifically turns affectionate evidence into proof of caring more.
comparison: A ticket album and its protection differ from physically sharing a heavy bag.
seedUse: Use D91-a gift and ticket reveal, distinguishing no separate collection from tickets preserved in the gifted album where needed.
